programme.title: Robin and Marian
programme.desc: Lange Jahre war Robin Hood (Sean Connery) auf sinnlosen Kreuzzügen unterwegs. Doch bei seiner Rückkehr nach England steht es schlimm um das Land. Der Sheriff von Nottingham (Robert Shaw) terrorisiert im Auftrag seines Herrn Sir Ranulf (Kenneth Haigh) die Bevölkerung. Mit ein paar treuen Gefolgsleuten kann Robin seine Jugendliebe Marian (Audrey Hepburn) aus den Kerkern des Sheriffs befreien, aber jetzt wird er von der ganzen Armee gejagt. Um unnötiges Blutvergießen zu vermeiden, schlägt Robin einen Zweikampf zwischen sich und dem Sheriff vor. Es kommt zum Duell auf Leben und Tod. Der Sieger entscheidet über Freiheit oder Knechtschaft der Bevölkerung.

programme.title: Keine Gute Tat (2014)
programme.desc: Terri (Taraji P. Henson) ist eine ergebene Ehefrau und Mutter zweier Kinder, die ein ideales Leben im Vorort von Atlanta führt. Doch eines Tages erscheint Colin (Idris Elba), ein charmanter aber gefährlicher Sträfling auf der Flucht, auf ihrer Schwelle und behauptet eine Autopanne zu haben. Terri bittet ihn herein und muss bald erfahren, dass keine gute Tat unbestraft bleibt, als sie ums Überleben kämpft.

programme.title: Shadow Man-Kurier Des Todes
programme.desc: Als verbrecherische Elemente innerhalb der C.I.A. ein gefährliches Virus aus den USA schmuggeln und den ehemaligen Nachrichtenoffizier Jack Foster (Steven Seagal) als Kurier einsetzen, ahnen sie nicht, welchen Zorn sie damit auf sich ziehen. Jack hat keine Ahnung von dem Plan, in den er unwissentlich verwickelt ist. Er nimmt seine Tochter nach Europa mit, wo sie von einem geheimnisvollen ausländischen Agenten entführt wird. Um sie zu retten und ihre Kidnapper zu finden, taucht Jack in die finstere Welt der internationalen Spionage ein, wo Feinde hinter jeder Ecke lauern und Freunde sich plötzlich gegen ihn wenden!

programme.title: Proud Mary

Als Mary einen geschützten Gangster erschießt, um einen kleinen Jungen zu retten, steht sie plötzlich mehreren Banden und Gangstern gegenüber, angefangen bei der russischen Mafia bis zu ihrem früheren Liebhaber. Mit geschärften Sinnen und einem Koffer voller Waffen muss Mary alles tun, um die Überlebende in diesem energiegeladenen und explosiven Action-Thriller zu sein.

programme.title: Northern Woods
programme.desc: It is a musical film a a tributeto the Nordic forest: it shows its development from a primeval wood to a cultivated forest. Once populated by wild animals such as wolves, bears, eagles, deer and musk oxen, complex re-enactment-scenes shot by dollies and helicopters vividly depict the colonization of the forest by the Celts and Germans. But as time progressed, the northern forest has on numerous occasions fallen victim to environmental degradation and overexploitation. Several provisions were made to protect this wild beauty. The Helsinki resolution of 1993, which stipulated that the woods be used in a way and in a magnitude which guarantees their biological variety and productiveness and vitality, is but one measure put in place to secure the preservation of the natural gem. Time-lapse photography and breath-taking shots show our main protagonist – the woods – in its stunning glory. This beautiful wooded land, changes throughout the seasons. Our woodland is a world-renowned ecological jewel. It is famous, well-known and loved by tourists, forest economists, environmentalists, historians and intellectuals alike.

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Magical Moors

Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. programme.title: Magic Lakes
programme.desc: At 117 square kilometres, the Müritz is the largest lake on German territory, but it’s far from the only one in the north east of the country. Even the Mecklenburg Lake District, between Waren and Feldberg, contains around 2 lakes alone. Thanks to the Müritz National Park the species diversity is particularly high in the region: half of the German crane population breeds in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; the osprey is typical of the Müritz area; the lively Eurasian otter hunts here; and the endangered red milan circles the skies above. Fred Bollmann knows the national park like hardly any other. The former ranger and voluntary nature conservationist is actively involved in the preservation of ‘his’ wildlife world. Filming for this production took two years. The outcome is a unique portrait of this stunning region.

programme.title: Germany's Wild Amazon
programme.desc: As one of Germany’s beauties, the river was the gem of Germanys landscape. But with industrialization it became the country’s hardest working river and like everything that has been overworked, it lost it magnificence and charm. Due to tender love and care, the river is now a reigning example of one of the most successful and outstanding renaturation projects in the country.The film shows never before seen shots of the river now pulsing with life. We will show you the winding river bed, spawning salmon, mating crabs and still-growing anchor ice. You will see dipper birds searching for food under water, kingfishers catching fish, a family life of badgers, foxes and a wide variety of birds. Come and meet the resurrected river Wupper!

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Sulcis Archipelago is located off the south-western coast of Sardinia and is part of the province of of southern Sardinia. The islands of San Pietro, Sant'Antioco and Isola Piana form the archipelago, together with several uninhabited islets and rocks form the archipelago. It belongs to the less known areas in Italy and is little developed for tourism. Nevertheless stars like Tom Cruise and Roberto Cavalli come here to enjoy the peace, seclusion and good food. The islanders are only moderately interested in these visitors, and their down-to-earth attitude has never lost.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Lake Iseo is located on the southern foothills of the Alps. It extends over the provinces of Brescia and Bergamo in the northern mainland of Italy. In the middle of Lake Iseo lies the largest island of the southern European inland waters. Monte Isola, as the island is called after its central mountain lies close to its two neighboring islands, Isola di San Paolo and Isola di Loreto. As early as the 11th century, a monastic association of Benedictines settled here. For many Italians, Lake Iseo is the most beautiful spot in their homeland. It is all the more astonishing how little the influence of tourism is here. Driving is strictly forbidden on the three islands, and only on Monte Isola. Only on Monte Isola there is a regular bus service in the summertime. Thus, the three islands are an oasis of an oasis of tranquility most of the year. The historical buildings and the nature remind of the long tradition in which the Italians have cultivated this retreat. Only every five years in the autumn a big celebration takes place. Then over 200,000 paper flowers decorate the island. The flowers are reminiscent of the time in the Middle Ages when a Roma woman brought her son to the island to be cured from the from the rampant plague. In gratitude, she donated a sea of flowers. The Festa di Santa Croce has been one of the main attractions in northern Italy ever since. The days are radiant with color, it is the only time when it gets crowded in the small streets of the island villages. The next festival was celebrated in September 2021.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Tuscan Archipelago is a group of islands at the height of Florence. The archipelago stretches from the Ligurian Sea to the Tyrrhenian Sea, north-east of Corsica. The archipelago consists of seven main islands - Giglio, Elba, Gianutri, Capraia, Pianisoa, Gorgona and Montecristo - and other smaller islands and rocks. Not all of them are inhabited. We look at the three most extraordinary islands of the archipelago: Elba, Capraia and the island of Montecristo. The Tuscan Archipelago is one of the most important natural wonders of the world and is protected as Parco Nazionale dell'Arcipelago Toscano. With its 61.474 hectares of protected and 17,694 hectares of protected land area, it is the largest marine protected area in in Europe. Capraia is the third largest island of the archipelago and is located with its small harbor in the channel in front of Corsica. The island is an autonomous municipality with about 300 inhabitants. It is also considered the most maritime island of the archipelago. At the end of the eighties, the penal colony on Capraia was closed was closed and the island opened to tourism.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Far from the glamour and spotlight of Lampedusa, Pantelleria is one of the best kept secrets among the Italian islands. Located closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria has been nicknamed "The Last Island," a title also given by Giosuè Calaciura gave to his 2016 historical novel set on Pantelleria. Pantelleria, that is the island of lava, capers and of the liqueur wine that comes here Zibibbo. An island with an ancient history, where for centuries farmers and fishermen have pursued their craft. their craft. The famous Zibibbo grapes are cultivated here - among other things also on the vineyard that Gerard Depardieu and his wife Carole Bouquet bought to produce traditional liqueur and nutmeg wine themselves and distribute it worldwide. The cuisine of the island is as much Arabic as Italian, couscous with fish is a typical island dish.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Life on the Amber Coast
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share the archipelago with Europe’s largest tern, the Caspian tern.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Enchanted Forests and Moors
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Bear Essentials
programme.desc: We follow three young bears of different species – polar bears, brown bears and sloth bears (like Baloo, the Jungle Book Bear) – that inhabit dramatically varied landscapes as they find their way in the world. We look at how their mothers teach them the skills they need to survive and watch the many dangers they face. Their young lives are full of learning, moments of great tenderness and life-threatening drama. Over three years all of our bears, despite hardships and losses along the way, prove they have what it takes, they all have learned their bear essentials.

programme.title: Hoanib - The Secret of the Desert Elephants
programme.desc: The Namib, one of the most hostile deserts on Earth. Without a firm survival strategy, no living soul will make it here. Yet, surprisingly, some species have adapted their lifestyles to these extreme conditions: chameleons, beetles, snakes and mammals are all at home here. The film follows a family of desert elephants that has also adapted to this habitat.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Down to Earth - Flightless Birds
programme.desc: They’ve given up the wonderful art of flying. Or was it an art they never possessed? The brain structure and anatomy of flightless birds indicate that they descended from "flyers" – so, why don’t they fly?

programme.title: Hunters of the Skies
programme.desc: Birds of prey are symbols of power, speed and splendour. In fact, there are very few species in the animal kingdom that can be described in as many superlatives. Their amazing use of different senses, their incredible feats of flight as well as their multitude of different hunting strategies are simply astounding. Hawks, buzzards and eagles have conquered every habitat on earth - from the dry arid south, to the cool and moist river valleys, to the coasts of Norway, all the way up to the sparse high mountains. Some of them, like the incredibly versatile hawk, can even hunt in the forest. Their literal eagle eye vision is unrivaled in the animal kingdom. All birds of prey sustain themselves through hunting, and they do so elegantly and, it seems, with effortless beauty and efficiency. This is one of many reasons why they are much admired, even romanticised, by many cultures. Buckle up and join us on this aerial adventure with spectacular insights into this amazing world of birds of prey.

programme.title: mareTV: Hong Kong - Metropolis in the sea
programme.desc: Hong Kong translated means "fragrant harbour". The days of the spicy smoking ceremonies have passed, but MareTV has discovered many delightful contrasts between the metropolis and Mother Nature. In for-mer times, the rare eagle wood tree grew here. Its wood put the spice into the Taoist smoking ceremonies. The fragrant harbour: what sounds so charming is today a huge metropolis in the sea. No other tiny piece of land is more densely populated. Star Ferries have been commuting between the Kowloon Peninsula and central Hong Kong for the past 125 years. The British colonial masters are long gone, but on the ancient ferries, virtually nothing has changed. Most of the ships are still clad in British Racing Green and the crew still wears the old, decorative uniforms.

programme.title: Sri Lanka - Tropics, temples and tea plantations
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.title: Mysterious Oceanic Oases - Hotspots of Life
programme.desc: Countless marine animals frolic on the steep slopes of underwater volcanoes. In many cases, several are rare species not found elsewhere. This is in part due to the fact that plankton clings to the wall and provides the fish with food in abundance. This documentary shows several of these oases and also examines the impact dive tourism has and whether preventive measures can help to maintain them. Nature and underwater filmmaker Rolf Möltgen undertakes dives into the mysterious underwater mountain landscapes with marine scientists from all corners of the globe. This journey takes us to Mexico, to snappers, white-tip reef sharks, Galapagos sharks and giant mantas. We visit the Maldives, Colombia and Costa Rica, where the team documents rare species such as deep sea burbots, small tooth sand tiger and dogfish sharks, in depths of more than 3 metres. The eerie underwater mountain world proves: everyone plays a part in the network of life. Thanks to consistent protective regulations, it has been possible to retain the underwater diversity - especially in the unique oases of the high seas

programme.title: Fair Trade - Cocoa From Ivory Coast (On the Road With Hannes Jaenicke)
programme.desc: Many everyday life goods get to us from all over the world. Even though they have crossed thousands of miles, their prices are shockingly low. On almost every occasion, this counts in to the disadvantage of the producers. While global players make gigantic profits, the farmers stay poor. Meanwhile, an alternative to this scenario does exist: Goods and products derived from fair trade. In Germany, labels like FAIRTRADE, GEPA, STEP or NATURLAND FAIR make the promise of trading while being aware of both sides of the production line. But can we really change things by our personal shopping tendencies only? Do we as consumers hold the power to change consumption for the better? The actor and author of bestseller books Hannes Jaenicke makes it his goal to find out exactly about these questions. In a journey around the globe, he visits various small farmers and producers who sell their products via fair trade. They show him how they live and work. What kind of people are they? And what has changed for them by getting organized in fair trade unions?

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.sub-title: The Psychogramm of a Spiritual Landscape
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse soll ein achtzigjähriger Ford ein paar PS zulegen, während die Porsche-Experten von 9elf einen äußerst seltenen Carrera 3.0 auf dem Weg zur erfolgreichen Hauptuntersuchung betreuen. Bei Il Motore steht ein Kellerfund vor der Entkernung: neuer Motor für einen alten Fiat 500. Eine top erhaltene DDR-Simson S50 findet ihren Weg zu den Spezialisten der Flying Classics.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Der Name ist Programm: Bei Il Motore dreht sich fast alles um Antriebsmaschinen. Minustemperaturen für die luftgekühlte Rarität von 9elf: Eisstrahlung beim Carrera 3.0. In der Halle der Flying Classics wartet ein schick überholtes Kultmoped auf die Abholung. Für eine Handvoll PS mehr muss sich der betagte Ford in Tom's Roadhouse von seinem Getriebe verabschieden.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Korrosion mit Coolnessfaktor: Auf dem Hof der Flying Classics landet eine Simson Schwalbe im Rost-Design. Die Porsche-Experten von 9elf verpassen dem frisch gestrahlten Carrera ein komplettes Check-up. In der Werkstatt von Il Motore wirkt strahlender Sand wahre Wunder. Motortausch für eine amerikanische Legende: In Tom's Roadhouse wartet ein Mustang auf seine neue Maschine.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Für den Carrera schlägt die Stunde der Wahrheit. Wird das edle Sammlerstück dem kritischen Prüfer-Blick standhalten? Der Il Motore-Chef jagt einen asiatischen Kultflitzer Marke Datsun auf den Leistungsstand. Geduldsprobe für den Vespa-Experten: Die Kupplung einer alten spanischen Vespa wird zum Problemfall. Auch die Montage des neuen Mustang-Motors wird zur kniffligen Herausforderung.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Nichts kann eine Schlammlawine aufhalten. Einmal ausgelöst, walzt sie erbarmungslos alles nieder. Drei Schlammlawinen in Kalifornien, Venezuela und Wales haben in der jüngeren Geschichte besonderes Entsetzen hervorgerufen, als sie teilweise ganze Landstriche unter sich begruben.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Neben Hungersnöten zählen Flutkatastrophen zu den humanitären Krisen mit den meisten Opfern der Geschichte. Eindrucksvolle Bilder zeigen die Ursachen anhand einiger der größten Überschwemmungen in jüngerer Zeit: Am Mississippi in den USA, an der Elbe in Deutschland und in New York City entfaltete sich die unaufhaltsame Gewalt großer Wassermassen.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Die Pandemie ist der unsichtbare Killer: Eine verheerende Krankheitswelle, die um den ganzen Globus wandert, wird angesichts der Bevölkerungsentwicklung immer wahrscheinlicher. So unterschiedliche Krankheiten wie Ebola und die Schweinepest zeigen, dass jeder Kontinent unvermittelt betroffen sein kann. Gesundheitsexperten sind überzeugt, dass das Risiko für eine weltumspannende Epidemie steigt.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Vulkane regen seit jeher unsere Fantasie an. Der tragische Untergang des römischen Pompeji übt bis heute eine morbide Faszination aus. Die Vorstellung schmelzenden Gesteins in feurigen Explosionen schürt Urängste und Alpträume. Vom italienischen Vesuv bis zum Kilauea auf Hawaii - schlafende und aktive Vulkane stellen eine immerwährende Bedrohung dar.

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen
programme.desc: TCC 78000 ist einer der leistungsstärksten landgebundenen Schwerlastkrane.

programme.title: Männer & Maschinen
programme.desc: Der Puma gilt als modernster Schützenpanzer der Welt, steht aber in der Kritik.

programme.title: 112 - Feuerwache Neukölln
programme.desc: Deutschlands älteste Berufsfeuerwehr arbeitet am Limit. Besonders betroffen: der Stadtteil Neukölln. Mehr als 2000 Mal im Monat rücken hier die Retter vom Dienst aus. Die Menschen greifen immer schneller zum Hörer und wählen 112, auch wenn‘s nicht wirklich brennt. Die Arbeit im rauen Bezirk im Zentrum Berlins gilt als besonders fordernd und spannend und zieht deshalb vor allem Feuerwehrleute an.

programme.title: 112 - Feuerwache Neukölln
programme.desc: Die Neuköllner Feuerwehrleute werden zu einem Motorrad-Unfall gerufen. Vor Ort wartet bereits eine Menschenmenge aus ebenso unbeteiligten, wie störenden Zuschauern. Gaffen aus Sensationslust und Respektlosigkeit gegenüber den Rettern ist in Neukölln ein wachsendes Problem. Stress ohne Ende - wenn die Arbeit der Feuerwehr zum Hindernislauf wird.

programme.title: 112 - Feuerwache Neukölln
programme.desc: Ein selbstmordgefährdeter Mann, eine Wohnung unter Wasser und ein Mann mit Verfolgungswahn. Neukölln gehört zu Berlins ärmsten Bezirken. Die Auswirkungen beschäftigen auch die Männer von der Feuerwehr rund um die Uhr. In einem Fall müssen die Retter sogar mehrmals ausrücken: Ein Obdachloser will partout nicht ins Krankenhaus. Einsatz in Neukölln - wenn die Armut krankmacht.

programme.title: 112 - Feuerwache Neukölln
programme.desc: Diesmal hält ein Wohnungsbrand in der Sonnenallee die Männer der Feuerwache Neukölln in Atem. Kaum angekommen, wird ihnen klar: Es sind noch Menschen in dem brennenden Haus. Die Wohnungen sind aber schwer zu erreichen. Jetzt wird allen alles abverlangt. Es bleibt jedoch nicht bei diesem Großeinsatz in ihrer Schicht.

programme.title: 112 - Feuerwache Neukölln
programme.desc: Neun Autos stehen in einem Neuköllner Hinterhof in Flammen - ein Einsatz, auch für erfahrene Feuerwehrmänner nicht alltäglich. War es Brandstiftung? Eine andere Herausforderung für die Truppe ist der Notruf aus einer Laubenkolonie: Ein Mann mit Herzinfarkt. Es geht um Leben und Tod.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Das Team 9elf steigt um. Statt mit Porsche geben die PS-Experten im VW-Beetle Gas auf der Rennstrecke. Ein betagter Italiener muss sich beweisen. Läuft der bei Il Motore überholte Fiat-Motor problemlos? In Tom’s Roadhouse bekommt das Ford-Hot Rod seine Achsen zurück. Wird die Problem-Kupplung der spanischen Vespa nach furioser Feinarbeit der Flying Classics wieder funktionieren?

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Beim Team 9elf treffen die langersehnten Edel-Felgen ein. Die Flying Classics bringen eine blaue Schwalbe auf Vordermann. Die Fachkenntnis des Il Motore-Teams ist ausnahmsweise bei einem Flugzeug-Oldie gefragt. Auch der Ford aus den 30er Jahren steht bei Tom's Roadhouse vor einer speziellen Premiere: Jungfernfahrt mit einem Gang mehr.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Ein Traumcabrio wartet bei Il Motore auf seine Motorrevision. Der Cadillac DeVille bringt die Fans von edlen Classic Cars zum Schwärmen. Das Team 9elf muss einen Porsche mit gestopften Rostlöchern durch die GTÜ-Prüfung bekommen. Außeneinsätze für die blaue Schwalbe bei den Flying Classics und den Mustang aus Tom's Roadhouse. Sind die Werkstatt-Eingriffe gut verlaufen?

programme.title: Vulkanismus in Deutschland
programme.desc: Der Geysir von Andernach ist mit über 60 Meter Höhe DIE Attraktion der Osteifel.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Länder wie Saudi-Arabien sind an Hitze über 40 Grad Celsius gewöhnt. Doch als 2010 eine Hitzewelle mit ähnlichen Temperaturen über Russland hereinbrach, starben geschätzt 56.000 Menschen. Und der europäische Supersommer 2003 hinterließ rund 70.000 Todesopfer. Außergewöhnliches Bildmaterial und Klimaspezialisten gewähren einen Einblick in die genauen Zusammenhänge der beiden Hitzekatastrophen.

programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Klirrende Kälte und beinharte Windböen kennzeichnen den Blizzard. Die Winterstürme sind Tötungsmaschinen der Natur. Sie bringen oft riesige Mengen Schnee - aber nicht immer, wie Wetterexperten erläutern. Am Beispiel zweier Blizzards an Nordamerikas Atlantikküste zeigen sie, welche Formen extreme Kälteeinbrüche annehmen können.

programme.title: Emergency Room Essen
programme.desc: Im größten Krankenhaus des Ruhrgebiets herrscht fast immer Ausnahmezustand. 24 Stunden täglich, an 365 Tagen im Jahr. Pausen gibt es für die Ärzte während ihrer langen Schichten kaum, auch weil immer häufiger Menschen mit kleinen Wehwehchen zu ihnen kommen. Sie wollen die Wartezeiten bei ihren Hausärzten umgehen. Die Folge: Mediziner und Pfleger sind am Limit.

programme.title: Emergency Room Essen
programme.desc: Wenn am Wochenende die Hausarztpraxen geschlossen sind, geht es hoch her in der Notaufnahme des Uniklinikums Essen. Patienten mit Verdacht auf Herzinfarkt, Schlaganfall oder andere lebensbedrohliche Krankheiten, werden sofort behandelt. Doch wer mit Husten, Schnupfen, Heiserkeit oder sonstigen Lappalien kommt, muss sich erstmal hintenanstellen. Wartezeit: manchmal über sieben Stunden.

programme.title: Berufsgeheimnisse
programme.desc: Für Neurochirurg Prof. Peter Vajkoczy steht eine komplizierte Operation an: eine Patientin mit einem Hypophysentumor. Beim Eingriff wendet der Hirnspezialist eine besondere Methode an. Er operiert durch die Nase der Patientin und vermeidet damit eine Öffnung des Schädels. Navena Widulin hütet den medizinhistorischen Schatz der Charité: die Präparatesammlung.

programme.title: Berufsgeheimnisse
programme.desc: An den geburtsmedizinischen Kliniken der Charite kommen jährlich rund 4600 Kinder zur Welt. Die Ärzte sind spezialisiert auf schwierige Fälle. Vor drei Jahren gelang dem Charite-Team eine Sensation: zum ersten Mal seit zwanzig Jahren in Deutschland wurden hier Sechslinge geboren.

programme.title: Berufsgeheimnisse
programme.desc: Prof. Henrich steht ein besonderer Kaiserschnitt bevor: eine 31-jährige erwartet Drillinge. Ein Team von rund 20 Ärzten und Schwestern ist bereit, um den Frühgeborenen sicher auf die Welt zu helfen. In der Abteilung von Professor Schaser steht ebenfalls eine aufwändige OP an. Einem 36-jährigen Unfallopfer wird ein Titangerüst in den Oberschenkel operiert.

programme.desc: We travel to the Japanese island known for having some of the oldest people on Earth. We engage with leading scientists who have identified the "Longevity Gene," offering a glimpse into the genetic factors that contribute to extended lifespans. Beyond genetics, we explore the deeply ingrained cultural practices that sustain long, fulfilling lives in Okinawa. We delve into the importance of "moai," a lifelong social network that supports residents into their golden years, and the principle of "Hara Hachi Bu," which advises eating until you're 80% full while focusing on nourishing foods. But at the core of Okinawan longevity, we find "ikigai"—a profound sense of life purpose. From practicing martial arts to active community participation, we discover that Okinawan seniors maintain a vibrant sense of purpose in various facets of life. Join us on this enlightening journey to learn how the pillars of social support, mindful eating, and a strong sense of ikigai could enhance your own quest for a long and fulfilling life.

programme.title: Dangerous Thirst
programme.desc: When Royelle's husband, Trevion, proposes delving into the swinging lifestyle, she reluctantly agrees, igniting a tumultuous sexual journey. What starts as a tantalizing exploration of their desires soon transforms into a journey fraught with jealousy, distrust, and emotional turmoil, threatening to unravel the very fabric of their marriage as she begins to find herself in a sex scandal, engulfed by lies, betrayal, and murder.

programme.title: Ultimatums
programme.desc: Roman visits recently engaged Luke and his sexually frustrated fiancé Mya. Mya is forced into an internal battle between being faithful to her fiancé and sexual tension between their new house guest who has an ulterior motive of his own.

programme.title: What She Wants
programme.desc: Vannaleese Poole is a street smart, businesswoman who knows how to use what she has to get what she wants. In Her relentless thirst to make major moves, she hooks up with Jay, a big time street boss, who promises her the world, but only if she follows the rules that she isn’t willing to play by. She meets Brint, a business mogul, who falls hard for her and gives her everything she wants. A test of love will introduces her to something she never knew she wanted.

programme.title: Secure the Bag 2
programme.desc: Greed is Lit's first love. Lit lost his uncle, who practically raised him, over money he stole from bank robbers. Lit decides to go back to the house where he lost his uncle, but Lit is hiding a secret. It wasn't just money he found.

programme.title: Romeo and Isabella
programme.desc: Trans woman, Isabella, has struggled to find the right man. When she goes back home, old friends and skeletons come back to find her. When she falls for Romeo, the neighborhood bad boy, they both find out falling in love may be a death sentence.

programme.title: Knee Deep
programme.desc: A young woman goes through a transformation to become a force to be reckoned with after witnessing a traumatic event. After learning about the game from her boyfriend and the art of the hustle, lies and deceit begin to tear her world apart.

programme.title: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Jessica is the smartest girl on campus tutoring the most popular football player, Ryan. He is loved by many but he also has a few enemies. After the football team wins the championship game, Ryan decides to throw an after party at his house. When campus police find Ryan’s dead body, multiple people have a motive to want him dead. Will Jessica and her friend uncover the truth before it’s too late?

programme.title: Fractured
programme.desc: When a woman stumbles upon undeniable proof of her husband's infidelity, reality takes an unexpectedly bizarre turn and the truth becomes stranger than fiction. This thrilling narrative is skillfully woven through the perspectives of multiple characters. With each character's viewpoint, fresh layers of information are unveiled, gradually unraveling a shocking twist that will leave viewers stunned, defying all expectations.

programme.title: Quiet as Kept
programme.desc: Jay is unlawfully detained. His ex-girlfriend returns, and his business partners work to clear his name. Meanwhile, a crooked cop is under suspicion for murder, and connections are made between him and Jay. Torn between duty and loyalty, Detective Johnson is caught in the middle. As the prosecution struggles, Jay and his business partners work to exist the dangerous world cleanly.

programme.title: South Side Hero
programme.desc: After serving a 10-year sentence on a RICO charge, reformed gangster Tommy ‘Ace’ Crown returns home to find his 15-year old daughter Sierra missing after she ran away with a man she met online. When the police decline to help, Ace is determined to track her down himself.

programme.title: Trap A Fool
programme.desc: After two years of what he thought was a perfect relationship, Jeremiah uncovers his beloved Shay-Shay's "black book" of men. He is forced to realize that her gentle nature was a facade, a calculated move in her "game of fools." Shay-Shay's only loves are herself, sex, and money, and their dangerous game is about to end.

programme.title: Double Standards 2
programme.desc: When Pastor Noble Jonez’s carefully constructed image begins to unravel, his wife Trezjiir is forced to confront not only the trauma of her past but the deceit poisoning her present. As buried secrets resurface—ranging from infidelity, hidden paternity, abuse of power, and criminal ties—every lie brings them closer to destruction.

programme.title: Love and Deceit 2
programme.desc: Carolyn, a successful businesswoman moves to a new town in hopes of laying down some roots after her divorce. She joins a local women’s group ran by Beverly Jordan a respected therapist to help process her emotions. When in reality, she’s there to rekindle an old flame with a former lover, who happens to be Beverly’s husband.

programme.title: The Price of Fame
programme.desc: In the streets of Atlanta, Cassie, a struggling young woman searching for purpose, meets Ryan, a charismatic interviewer who offers her a chance to step into the world of fame and opportunity. With guidance from her cunning best friend, Ledrick, Cassie navigates the glamorous yet cutthroat entertainment industry. But as hidden agendas and betrayals emerge, Cassie finds herself questioning the cost of her dreams.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: Monster Jam heads across the border to the streets of Montreal, Canada, at Olympic Stadium for the first time in almost a decade.

programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.desc: The Ford Center in Evansville transforms into a high-stakes battleground for the Freestyle Mania Championship Series. Six superstar drivers compete in a grueling gauntlet featuring the blistering speed of JCB Racing, the technical precision of the Two Wheel Skills Challenge, and a high-flying Freestyle finale. From the rookie flair of Kylie Kent in Sparkle Smash to the jaw-dropping stunts of Megalodon and Zombie, this "buck wild" event is a masterclass in raw horsepower and fearless competition.

programme.title: Monster Jam TV
programme.desc: Monster Jam goes to Holland! The Gelredome, in Arnhem hosts as Team Marvel and Team Destruction go head to head.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: The gauntlet has been thrown- a past champion goes up against the current champ in a battle for the top in Minneapolis, MN at the Metrodome.

programme.title: Championship Series

programme.title: Arena Series in 30
programme.desc: Monster Jam's Arena in 30 makes it's next stop in Rosemont, IL with more racing and freestyle fun.

programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.desc: Monster Jam Replay arrives at the InTrustBank Arena in Wichita, Kansas, for a pivotal Round 8 of the Arena Championship Series West. The stakes are higher than ever as the top two drivers in the series—Blake Granger and Armando Castro—face off in a high-pressure JCB Racing matchup that could shift the season leaderboard. Fans are treated to the technical brilliance of the Two Wheel Skills Challenge, featuring daring combos and gravity-defying maneuvers from the likes of Matt Cody in Grave Digger and Tim Hall Jr. in Jurassic Attack. The evening reaches a fever pitch during the Freestyle segment, where "Daredevil Diva" Angelina Nock takes Megalodon to the skies and Cliff Turner hunts for a breakthrough performance in Velociraptor. Witness the passion and raw power as these elite athletes push their 12,000-pound machines to the absolute edge for the Wichita crowd.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nos anos 70, os modelos W 114/115 da Mercedes ofereciam engenharia sólida a preços moderados, o que fez com que o sedan com estilo Paul Braq se tornasse o primeiro Mercedes para pessoas comuns. Também: um inconspícuo Volkswagen Beetle de 1972 com 90 cv que atingiu 180 km/h na Autobahn. E: um marco na história automotiva da época: o NSU RO 80 com um motor rotativo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nos anos 50, o Tatra da Tchecoslováquia introduziu carros avançados, até mesmo pioneiros. A clientela era exclusiva, e é por isso que estes carros são muito raros hoje em dia. Encontramos o proprietário de um Tatra T87 de 1937.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O Porsche 911 Targa, com sua construção leve, é um carro icônico. Além disso: o Lotus Seven Twin Cam SS é mais um carro de corrida do que um carro de estrada. E: o Bentley Blower de 1930 e o Sunbeam Tiger Roadster.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O GTA da Ford Fairlane de 1967 na forma NASCAR. Além disso: O Chrysler 300 C de 1995 era o veículo de produção mais potente dos Estados Unidos. E: o Cadillac série 62 conversível de 1949 estabelece novos padrões em luxo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O Triumph 1800 Roadster de 1947 oferece espaço para 5 entusiastas do ar fresco. Mais: The Jog, o rally de carros clássico mais difícil da Europa. E: o Wolseley Stellite de 1919.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: No final dos anos 50, a Facel Vega Facellia foi projetada para competir com a Porsche e a Alfa Romeo e abrir um novo segmento de mercado para a jovem empresa francesa de carros de luxo.

programme.title: BMW M3 Test Drive - A BMW de maior sucesso de todos os tempos!
programme.desc: Nos anos 80, a BMW lançou um carro que tinha verdadeiros genes de corrida, o M3. Originalmente concebido como modelo de homologação para o Campeonato Alemão de Carros de Turismo, tornou-se num dos carros desportivos de estrada mais quentes do mundo.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE encontra a America - Long Island
programme.desc: Não é coincidência que os carros esportivos italianos sejam considerados as jóias da coroa em sua categoria. Todos conhecem Ferrari, Maserati, Lamborghini e Alfa Romeo, mas e a Iso Rivolta? A marca desapareceu, mas a lenda continua viva entre os entusiastas. Há vários carros daquela lenda quase esquecida em um museu de carros particulares na Flórida.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE encontra a America - Florida
programme.desc: O que é o carro americano dos anos 60? Qual é o símbolo da fabricação de carros americanos? Para muitos é o Corvette ou o Ford Mustang. Na busca por esses carros de sonho americanos dos anos 60, Tillmann Miritz faz uma descoberta surpreendente na Flórida: o Ford Mustang de 1964.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE encontra a America - Florida 2
programme.desc: O que é o carro americano dos anos 60? Qual é o símbolo da fabricação de carros americanos? Para muitos é o Corvette ou o Ford Mustang. Na busca por esses carros de sonho americanos dos anos 60, Tillmann Miritz faz uma descoberta surpreendente na Flórida: o Ford Mustang de 1964.

programme.title: A Unidade de Carros Especiais da Polícia de Dubai
programme.desc: Pela primeira vez, a unidade de carros especiais da Polícia de Dubai permite que uma equipe de TV acompanhe seus agentes em patrulha. Estes não são carros normais da polícia porque esta não é uma cidade normal.

programme.title: A bordo da McLaren 570 GT
programme.desc: A bordo da McLaren 570 GT na ilha de Tenerife

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Ao ganhar o icônico Rally Dakar 13 vezes, o francês Stephane Peterhansel teve uma carreira bastante incomum quando mudou de motocicletas para carros e desfrutou de enorme sucesso com ambos os veículos.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Alois Ruf é o fundador de uma pequena, mas conhecida empresa fabricante de carros na Baviera, especializada em construir sua própria visão de carros super esportivos legais de rua sobre a fundação de carrocerias Porsche.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Dos anos 50 aos 70, Hans Herrmann ganhou fama como piloto de Fórmula 1 e de carros esportivos para fabricantes como Porsche, Mercedes-Benz e Maserati, que também ganhou as 24 Horas de Le Mans várias vezes.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: As pessoas a chamavam de "Rainha da Nordschleife". Sabine Schmitz foi uma piloto de corridas de sucesso antes de trabalhar como apresentadora para a televisão alemã e mais tarde para o famoso programa da BBC "Top Gear".

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Bentley New Flying Spur e o Rolls Royce Wraith são ambos uma raça extremamente exclusiva de carros. Com mais de 600 cv, estes pacotes de potência luxuosos proporcionam uma experiência de direção quase transcendental e proporcionam a combinação perfeita de elegância e desempenho, para aqueles que podem se dar ao luxo de um luxo tão extravagante.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Há nomes que soam como música nos ouvidos dos entusiastas de automóveis: o Mc Laren MP4 12C, o Porsche 911 Turbo S e o Mercedes SLS AMG GT. MOTORVISION tem uma condução nestas excitantes máquinas de condução.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: 1.000 quilômetros na famosa Nürburgring. É a corrida final da temporada de 2013. A Blancpain Endurance Series é um evento de corridas para grandes turistas como a Ferrari 458 Italia, a McLaren MP4-12 C ou o Nissan GT-R Nismo GT3. Demos uma olhada em toda a ação, os pilotos, seus carros e a competição.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL 'Leve'
programme.desc: Um carro de corrida icônico e um dos únicos 29 já construídos! Acompanhamos o Mercedes 300 SL 'Leve' em sua estréia no Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: Com a Bentley Bentayga, a tradicional marca britânica está entrando no segmento de mercado que mais cresce. Este primeiro SUV de luxo do mundo é um conglomerado de superlativos sobre rodas.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Smart também ofereceu o seu icónico carro citadino com opção de descapotável. O Mini cabriolet é maior, não apenas debaixo do capô. Oferece espaço para quatro pessoas. Quando se trata de uma grande sensação de roadster, o Mazda MX-5 está no topo da lista. Demos uma vista de olhos mais atenta a estes três concorrentes de topo aberto.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: O Salão Automobilístico de Paris é o salão automobilístico mais antigo do mundo e dá uma visão do mundo automotivo. Em 2016, a Mercedes apresentou sua sub-marca "Generation EQ", e a Volkswagen anunciou a construção de 20 novos modelos eletrificados.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Para alguns, a forma de cupê tem um apelo mais sexy, mas por que alguém escolhe um cupê de duas portas como o Mercedes E400 em vez do CLS com quatro portas? Além disso: independentemente do preço diferente, a Volkswagen Arteon ainda desafia o CLS.

programme.title: Incrível Jaguar F-Type R Tuning: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: Um Jaguar que pode atacar o medo no mundo apenas com o seu rugido. Este Jaguar Arden-tuned F-Type R é um verdadeiro mau rapaz. Já tem uma verdadeira dentada na configuração padrão, mas o Arden é mais forte, mais alto e mais agressivo.

programme.title: Volvo S90
programme.desc: Parece mais esportivo do que se poderia esperar dos suecos. Os faróis traseiros emolduram a poderosa parte traseira. No interior, o Volvo S90 impressiona com os materiais mais finos e o couro macio da napa.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: O Audi S8 Plus não é de forma alguma subestimado, mas é e permanece fiel à subestimação desta série de modelos. Aqueles que querem mais poder podem obter um impulso da MTM.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: Traccao as quatro rodas em vagoes de estacao
programme.desc: Os vagões de estação são geralmente considerados como carros familiares ou apenas veículos com muitos porões de carga. Mas o Skoda Octavia, o Opel Insignia Country Tourer, o Subaru Outback, o Audi S4 allroad quattro e o Seat Leon x-perience querem ser mais do que isso. Seu visual offroad atrai o aventureiro interno e sua tração 4x4 proporciona a tração certa em terreno acidentado. Nem sempre tem que ser um SUV.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Neste episódio, damos uma olhada em alguns dos exemplares mais extremos do mundo offroad: um monster truck Fiat Panda cujos pneus têm um diâmetro de 1,5 metros, um Ford Raptor com 600 hp, uma conversão de um Mercedes G-class Edition da ORC, um Volkswagen Touareg R-Line modificado da JE Design, um Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT8, o carro-chefe da marca, e o Fiat Panda Cross.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Na Lexus, a divisão de veículos de luxo da Toyota, a última tendência foi para formas angulares e uma aparência mais agressiva. Com seu design extravagante, o NX200t definitivamente se destaca. A Infiniti, divisão de luxo da Nissan, é mais conservadora a esse respeito. O QX30 apresenta um design clássico do Infiniti com um capô curvo e uma aparência energética. Além disso: o SUV Mazda CX-3 da cidade.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Três irmãos da mesma plataforma de produção Volkswagen: o Skoda Kodiaq oferece espaço para sete pessoas e pontua com um preço inicial favorável, o Volkswagen Tiguan é um pouco mais caro, mas oferece uma gama mais ampla de motores e gadgets mais técnicos, e o Seat infunde o segmento SUV com a paixão espanhola.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: Classe empresarial com tracao nas quatro rodas
programme.desc: O Jaguar XF-S deve pressionar a BMW, a Audi e os outros concorrentes no segmento de classe executiva. Os britânicos querem ensinar aos melhores cães alemães o verdadeiro significado da palavra medo. A Volvo tem uma abordagem diferente. Seu S90 é cativante devido a seu design escandinavo e motores econômicos de quatro cilindros.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: ORZ Veículos, uma empresa alemã especializada na produção, venda e instalação de peças e acessórios para jipes, faz com que o sonho americano fora da estrada se torne realidade para os europeus. Um bom exemplo desta abordagem é o Brute, uma versão pickup do Wrangler que tem muito pouco em comum com o modelo de produção.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Compactos e mini SUVs são perfeitos para a cidade enquanto suas capacidades off-road são menos importantes. O Seat Arona é um típico representante desta gama de modelos específicos. Outro pseudo off-roader é o Volkswagen T-Roc. O menor SUV Volkswagen pode repetir o sucesso do Volkswagen Tiguan mais vendido? Também: os concorrentes asiáticos Hyundai Kona, KIA Stonic e Toyota C-HR.

programme.title: Chris Pfeiffer analisa a BMW F 800 R
programme.desc: A BMW F 800 R é robusta e tem muito temperamento. O campeão mundial Chris Pfeiffer mostra o quanto se pode divertir com um BMW F 800 R. A sua bicicleta de trabalho é baseada na versão que pode comprar.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: O Audi S8 Plus não é de forma alguma subestimado, mas é e permanece fiel à subestimação desta série de modelos. Aqueles que querem mais poder podem obter um impulso da MTM.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.sub-title: Historia do carro - Historia da BMW
programme.desc: Prazer de dirigir: A BMW, um dos grupos automotivos de maior sucesso do mundo, promete exatamente isso. Os carros e motos esportivos da Bavarian Motorenwerke AG são igualmente populares entre os clientes e nos esportes de corrida.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: É o Porsche "James Dean", a Spyder 550. É pequeno, plano e rápido. E foi construído apenas 140 vezes. Mas mesmo assim, a aranha Porsche 550 escreve a história. E é o carro em que a lenda de Hollywood, James Dean, morre em um acidente. A História Automotiva conta toda a história do carro dos sonhos dos anos 50.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Seja em Rallye, Circuito ou Indianápolis. Por mais de 100 anos, as corridas têm sido a força motriz da Ford. Os heróis daquela época são agora lendas.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: A BMW é um dos fabricantes de automóveis de maior sucesso no mundo. Desde o início, as corridas têm sido um dos principais componentes. E a transferência de tecnologia é uma grande vantagem, especialmente para os clientes.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Nos anos 80 e 90, a Porsche corre de vitória em vitória. Uma McLaren vence três vezes a Copa do Mundo de Fórmula 1 com a Porsche power. A Porsche de 1982 começa uma série de vitórias em Le Mans. As décadas de 1980, 1990 e 2000 são os anos dourados do automobilismo para a Porsche. A História Automotiva mostra os carros mais rápidos, as corridas mais emocionantes e os pilotos mais famosos.

programme.title: Glas 1700 GT
programme.desc: O Glas GT parece uma Ferrari, mas vem da província da Baixa Baviera, na Alemanha. No início dos anos 60, era um dos poucos carros esportivos alemães.

programme.title: Peugeot 205 Turbo 16

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Days of Thunder - um evento de 1/8 milhas onde todos podem testar a velocidade do seu carro ou motocicleta. Mas atingimos o local com um BMW X6 M de Haman com mais de 600 cv.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Já na oitava temporada da German Race Wars, visitantes de mais de 20 países fazem uma peregrinação ao mega-evento. E: O Mini John Cooper Works é a versão de corrida do piloto bávaro. Arden o transforma no Arden Mini AM 3.

programme.title: Tuning

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Uma vez por ano, os fãs de afinação de carros de todo o país se encontram no Neue Messe Dresden para o XS Carnight. Em 35.000 metros quadrados há sonhos de carros a serem vistos aqui enquanto as luzes se apagam do lado de fora.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Ao contrário das inúmeras reuniões do carro Show & Shine, no Rust'n'Roll quanto mais velho melhor. Somente quando os veículos parecem realmente velhos e enferrujados, são considerados bonitos.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: A NitrolympX é um evento esportivo motorizado que foi realizado pela primeira vez em Hockenheim, em 1986. Com cerca de 30.000 espectadores e cerca de 300 participantes, é o maior evento internacional de drag race da Europa.

Maria Gracia sinti ndose cansada de la triste actitud de Lu s Fernando se decide a enfrentarlo en un reproche al saberlo pensando en Dileidy. programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión

programme.desc: Betania llega a la casa de los Nu ez con nimos de saber toda la verdad con respecto a su madre, Emperatriz e In s observan a Betania sin percatarla de su presencia. programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, Mar a Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandon a las dos mucho tiempo atr s para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de Mar a Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que tambi n tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Mar a Antonieta fallece despu s de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo le confiesa a Irene que quiere renunciar a la presidencia de la empresa, pero Irene insiste en que no lo haga. María Lucía cae en la trampa de Rodrigo. Pero inocente le comenta a Trinidad sobre lo sucedido con este señor. Trinidad tiene fuertes sospechas, sobre todo por lo que le había comentado Virginia. Agustina se sobresalta con tantos cambios que Leonardo está haciendo en la casa y continúa llenándoles la cabeza a los niños en contra de Irene. Trinidad visita a Virginia y le comenta lo que pasó con María Lucía y con respecto al hombre que se le apareció.

Felicita se re ne con sus amigas para desahogar ante ellas su depresi n tras incluso sentirse con ganas de morirse tras su ruptura con Aureliano, Tatiana al saber de la ruptura de Aureliano y Felicita planifica de inmediato un plan de ataque para la conquista de Aureliano para inmediatamente dejarse sorprender por el hecho de que este ya s encuentra en una relaci n con Dileidy. En la bodeguita de Gabito, Dileidy y Aureliano proclaman su relaci n recibiendo as el apoyo de todos. Maria Gracia sinti ndose cansada de la triste actitud de Lu s Fernando se decide a enfrentarlo en un reproche al saberlo pensando en Dileidy. Al seguir el consejo de la campa a contra el c ncer de mamas todas las mujeres de esta historia se practican el examen rutinario para la detecci n de n dulos en sus senos, al reconocer su propio descuido de tener tiempo de no practicarse el examen Egl e detecta una protuberancia en su pecho. Egl e se deja invadir por el temor de incluso llegar a perder la vida por causa de la palpable existencia de un n dulo en su seno, sinti ndose preocupada por el echo de llegar a dejar de existir para su familia, Lu s Fernando y Cristina no ayudan a que Egl e haga mas llevadera su preocupaci n al insistir en discutir por tonter as y hacer una batalla campal de la nada. Tras recibir la visita de sus padres, Betzaida habla maravillas del comportamiento de R mulo para con ella y su reci n nacida hija. Al sentirse sumamente preocupada por su hallazgo sin quererlo Egl e interviene en la vida familiar de R mulo y Betzaida al requerir la ayuda de su ex esposo para informarlo de su temor al creerse padeciendo de c ncer de mama. Cumpliendo el presagio de Gladys, Gerson llega a su casa para saber la verdad de la paternidad de Paco por boca de su propia madre. A pesar de los reclamos de su nueva esposa Betzaida R mulo decide mantener en secreto la situaci n de Egl e al tambi n sentirse preocupado de llegar a perder a la madre de sus hijos. Ante los lamentos sin sentido de Pascuita Gladys en actitud ir nica le da un alo de ligereza a sus propios problemas. Matilde y Moncho ven cumplidos sus deseos al ser enviados por Marco Aurelio a las obras de Nirgua.

programme.title: Amor, Felicidade Ou Casamento

programme.title: As Origens do Universo
programme.desc: O mundo que nos rodeia contém muitos sistemas complexos que funcionam perfeitamente juntos. Durante muitos anos, houve um debate acalorado entre evolução e criação, com a questão central de tudo: “A Terra foi criada ou surgiu por conta própria?” Conheça sete especialistas em suas áreas que dedicaram suas vidas ao estudo dessa questão.

programme.title: A Colheita
programme.desc: Para escapar de seus problemas conjugais, uma jovem família viaja da cidade para passar o verão em um vilarejo Amish, onde uma presença malévola toma conta do lugar. Os visitantes logo descobrem que foram levados para lá por uma razão e devem se libertar antes que o domínio demoníaco os consuma.

programme.title: O Amor Está Por Aí
programme.sub-title: O Amor Esta Por Ai - Episodio 41
programme.desc: Matilda diz a Brela que ela deveria ter coragem de ficar com Gabito e pergunta se ela realmente o ama. Brela conta em casa sobre o acidente de sua patroa e como Aidé descobriu o caso de Rômulo e Beatriz.

programme.title: O Amor Está Por Aí
programme.sub-title: O Amor Esta Por Ai - Episodio 42
programme.desc: Beatriz visita Rômulo justo quando Aidé está com ele no quarto do hotel. Ao ver Beatriz beijando Rômulo, Aidé diz que está sobrando ali e se retira.

programme.title: O Amor Está Por Aí
programme.sub-title: O Amor Esta Por Ai - Episodio 43
programme.desc: Matilda diz a Livi que o tipo de homem por quem ela deveria estar apaixonada é alguém como Armando. Livi não gosta disso e avisa que não é certo iludir Armando.

programme.title: O Amor Está Por Aí
programme.sub-title: O Amor Esta Por Ai - Episodio 44
programme.desc: Após um longo tempo separados, Rodrigo e Matilda se reencontram na universidade. A atração entre os dois ainda é forte e eles não conseguem ficar afastados.

programme.title: O Amor Está Por Aí
programme.sub-title: O Amor Esta Por Ai - Episodio 45
programme.desc: Quando Brela e Gabito estão em um momento especial, brindando por seus planos e possível casamento, aparece a única pessoa capaz de estragar tudo.

programme.title: O Amor Está Por Aí
programme.sub-title: O Amor Esta Por Ai - Episodio 46
programme.desc: Depois de acertar no presente, Armando espera que Matilda lhe dê uma chance. Ele diz que estará sempre ao lado dela e precisa que ela diga o mesmo. Matilda está considerando.

programme.title: O Amor Está Por Aí
programme.sub-title: O Amor Esta Por Ai - Episodio 47
programme.desc: Matilda fala com Rodrigo sobre seus ciúmes em relação às mulheres ao redor dele. Rodrigo pede que ela o leve a sério e diz que, assim, ele esquece todas as fãs.

programme.title: A Maldição da Sereia
programme.desc: Uma sereia é arrancada do Pacífico, seu rabo é cortado e ela é jogada em um hospício, onde ninguém acredita que ela é uma sereia.

programme.title: O Mal está Lá Fora
programme.desc: Um xerife faz uma descoberta estranha quando ele está é chamado a um pomar onde três irmãs adolescentes foram atacadas por um bando de jovens delinquentes.

programme.title: O Dom da Premonição
programme.desc: Annie Wilson (Cate Blanchett) uma viúva e mãe de três filhos, que possui também dons psíquicos. Para ganhar dinheiro, Annie resolve utilizar seus poderes oferecendo leituras psíquicas aos moradores da cidade onde reside, o que lhe custa a desconfiança da ala mais conservadora da população. Porém, tudo começa a piorar para Annie quando ela começa também a ver o lado negro das pessoas sua volta, ao mesmo tempo em que ocorre um assassinato na cidade. Com isso, ela precisará utilizar seus dons psíquicos para auxiliar a polícia local a solucionar o assassinato.

programme.title: Ring: O Chamado
programme.desc: Um vídeo misterioso foi associado a uma série de mortes e, quando uma jornalista curiosa encontra a fita e a assiste, isso desencadeia uma cadeia de eventos que colocam sua própria vida em perigo.

programme.title: A Casa da Morte
programme.desc: Um grupo de limpeza de cenas de crime luta para escapar de uma casa em que um brutal assassinato aconteceu, depois de ficarem presos ali por um antigo demônio nórdico que está determinado a deixálos loucos.

programme.title: Busca Alucinante
programme.desc: Mary acompanha o namorado ao hospital para a cirurgia ortopédica dele. Enquanto toma um café na cafeteria, ele desaparece. Ele não aparece no computador do hospital nem nas câmeras de segurança.

programme.title: A Possessão de Mary
programme.desc: David (Gary Oldman) é um capitão de colarinho azul que luta para melhorar a vida de sua família. Estranhamente atraído por um navio abandonado que está em leilão, David impulsivamente compra o barco, acreditando que será o bilhete de sua família para a felicidade e a prosperidade. Mas logo depois que eles embarcam em sua jornada inaugural, eventos estranhos e assustadores começam a aterrorizar David e sua família, fazendo com que se voltem um contra o outro e duvidem de sua própria sanidade.

programme.title: Luta Pela Liberdade
programme.desc: No estado de Manchukuo, nos anos 30, quatro agentes especiais do Partido Comunista, após retornarem à China, embarcam em uma missão secreta. Exausta por um traidor, a equipe se vê rodeada de correção de todos os lados.

programme.title: Rostos na Multidão
programme.desc: Um thriller de terror centrado em uma mulher que vive com "prosopagnosia" após sobreviver ao ataque de um assassino em série. Enquanto convive com sua condição, na qual suas feições mudam cada vez que ela as perde de vista, o assassino se aproxima cada vez mais.

É uma batalha épica e sangrenta para reencontrar a alma que perdeu anos antes nas ruas de uma cidade implacável.

programme.title: O Som da Música
programme.desc: Em “O Som da Música”, Jacarelvis e seus amigos apresentam as características e sons de diversos instrumentos musicais pertencentes a diferentes culturas. Cada episódio é dedicado a algum instrumento específico, onde são apresentados brevemente a história, os atributos e funcionamento de instrumentos como o violão, o xilofone, a gaita, piano, flauta, entre outros. E a festa sonora fica por conta de Jacarelvis e seus amigos, que apresentam as suas habilidades musicais com cada um dos instrumentos.

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Viaje para um mundo mágico onde o simpático Mago das Formas revela os segredos dos desenhos! Em cada episódio, três novos desenhos são criados usando formas geométricas básicas e elementos surpresa. Desafios de atenção e curiosidades tornam essa série divertida e educativa, ensinando o conceito de desenho por meio de formas geométricas. Divirta-se e aprenda com o Mago das Formas!

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos
programme.desc: Prepare-se para cantar, dançar e aprender! No Volume 01, Jacarelvis e sua turma misturam rock, reggae, blues e até bossa-nova para transformar o dia a dia das crianças em música e diversão. Entre abelhinhas parceiras, escovação de dentes, frutas, bichinhos de estimação e até lições sobre arrumar a bagunça, cada clipe traz humor, energia e muito aprendizado em ritmo animado!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Eles podem ser chamados de Curtas, mas com eles a diversão não é nada curta. Junte-se às sensações mundiais, Talking Tom and Friends, nessa série ágil e divertida, onde os seus jogos preferidos ganham vida diante dos seus olhos! Veja as aventuras hilariantes deles e prepare-se para sorrir sem parar!

programme.title: Cante com o Bubu
programme.desc: A série musical da Coruja Pequena está repleta de músicas super divertidas de alta qualidade, escritas com cuidado, talento e originalidade. Cada uma delas vem em um estilo musical diferente para que as crianças possam aprender e se divertir cantando junto.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger é uma série animada em 3D vibrante e envolvente, criada para crianças de 1 a 8 anos, que dá vida às aventuras do dia a dia por meio de músicas cativantes e encantadoras. Com uma variedade de personagens coloridos e temas ricos e diversos, a série retrata os momentos alegres da vida da família BarryTiger. A produção musical de alta qualidade — com melodias, arranjos e interpretações de excelência — adiciona ainda mais diversão às cenas animadas e sempre surpreendentes. Prepare-se para cantar, dançar e explorar com Barry e seus amigos em cada episódio emocionante!

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: Domi Kids é uma série musical animada em 3D que dá vida às alegres e afetuosas aventuras diárias da família Domi, composta por cinco membros. Com músicas animadas e divertidas, e performances de vários personagens, o programa oferece uma ampla variedade de temas, histórias envolventes e cenários diversificados. A equipe profissional de produção musical garante melodias de alta qualidade, arranjos cativantes e interpretações vocais impecáveis, proporcionando um verdadeiro banquete audiovisual para as crianças. O conteúdo é positivo, divertido e pensado para ajudar as crianças a aprenderem e explorarem o mundo de forma apropriada para sua idade. Também apoia os pais em sua jornada de uma criação mais leve e prazerosa, acompanhando o crescimento e o florescimento dos pequenos

Cada episódio é dedicado a algum instrumento específico, onde são apresentados brevemente a história, os atributos e funcionamento de instrumentos como o violão, o xilofone, a gaita, piano, flauta, entre outros. E a festa sonora fica por conta de Jacarelvis e seus amigos, que apresentam as suas habilidades musicais com cada um dos instrumentos.

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Viaje para um mundo mágico onde o simpático Mago das Formas revela os segredos dos desenhos! Em cada episódio, três novos desenhos são criados usando formas geométricas básicas e elementos surpresa. Desafios de atenção e curiosidades tornam essa série divertida e educativa, ensinando o conceito de desenho por meio de formas geométricas. Divirta-se e aprenda com o Mago das Formas!

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos

Entre abelhinhas parceiras, escovação de dentes, frutas, bichinhos de estimação e até lições sobre arrumar a bagunça, cada clipe traz humor, energia e muito aprendizado em ritmo animado!

programme.title: Sennentuntschi
programme.desc: 1975, Swiss Alps: In a remote mountain village, a beautiful and mysterious woman shows up. Only the village policeman takes care of the strange woman and tries to find out who she is. There are hints that she came from the H??henalp Alp, where herdsmen do unthinkable things to get the company of women. Many dark truths are revealed that should better have remained hidden. A tragedy of lust, insanity and murder is brought to a seemlingly pure and perfect world. It is the beginning of a nightmare of religious insanity, hypocrisy, abuse and belief in demons, who destroys a young family and brings a whole village to destruction.

programme.title: Psychos in Love
programme.desc: A strip-joint owner and a manicurist find that they have many things in common, the foremost being that they are psychotic serial killers. They fall in love and are happy being the family that slays together, until one day they come up against a plumber who also happens to be a cannibal.

programme.title: The Coed and the Zombie Stoner
programme.desc: When a sorority girl falls in love with a zombie, it's only a matter of time before a zombie apocalypse is unleashed on campus. The sorority girl discovers that weed is the cure. Now, she must smoke out the whole school before it's too late.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

Birds have faced a full season of hunting pressure, and they’re always a moment away from flipping the switch into summer patterns. But those last few eager longbeards make it worth the grind. In this episode of the Turkey POSSE, Grant Hudgens tags his first ever out-of-state strutter and becomes a card-carrying member of the Turkey POSSE.

programme.title: The Raven Project

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: It’s still opening week of bow season in Oklahoma and the crew has three tags left to fill.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation
programme.desc: “Part of our responsibility as citizens in this country is to make sure we not only take care of these resources but we hand it off to the next generation in better condition that we found it.” -Bob Ziehmer, Senior Director of Conservation for Bass Pro Shops & Cabela's Join Bob in New Mexico as he talks about taking care of our natural resources for future generations. Special thanks to Express UU Bar Ranch

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: For the first time in history, the World English Sporting Clays Championship was held in the United States at the incredible M&M Hunting Preserve owned by the Matarese family in New Jersey. Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Knowing when to spot and stalk is crucial for any hunter. In this episode of DDH-TV, Mark Kayser breaks down three key factors for success, while Dan Schmidt puts them into action as he stalks a buck in Nebraska’s Sandhills.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: On day three of Mark Peterson’s South America Upland Slam adventure, the guys are snowed in while waiting to head to La Pampa, where the weather promised to be much better. After a tense wait for the go-ahead to fly out, they finally touched down in La Pampa and headed straight to the field. There, the grasslands and scattered thickets provide the perfect habitat for Bushed Tinamou, known for their elusive nature and penchant for hiding among dense underbrush. Day four is dedicated to hunting these Tinamou, with Mark eager to track them in their natural habitat. On day five, their focus shifts to Pigeons, where they set up decoys along the edge of a cut cornfield. The anticipation of drawing in flocks makes for an incredible hunt and Mark can’t wait to see what the day will bring.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: With over 20 years of service, retiring as a Senior Chief Machinery Technician, Steven served abord multiple Coast Guard cutters, led critical missions, protected our nation's leaders, and earned the Coast Guard Achievement Medal for his outstanding service. Beyond the uniform, Steven has has spent decades giving back - coaching youth sports, mentoring young athletes, and living the values of service, leadership, and integrity. Steven's dedication didn't end with retirement - and neither does our gratitude. We were honored to have Steven at Thumbtack Ranch and are even more grateful for his service.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We love our college chapters. Hudson has been a long time member of TTHA as well as serving with the Texas A&M Chapter. We have a great time at G2 in pursuit of Axis deer.

programme.desc: In this episode Slade and the old Trained Assassins (TAT) crew head to Montrose, Colorado where they meet up with Slade’s dad, Bear Cub, TJ, and George for a heck of a week at Elk Camp. This is all going on now on Hunting Land Man TV.

Two days later, the hot streak continues with Slade connecting on another turkey on an 83 acre property he has for sale! Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

programme.desc: TA Mahoney is a classic mom and pop store known for going the extra mile and treating everyday people like family. Keep an eye on Mike though, you never know what kind of prank is up his sleeve.
